President Trump just explicitly called on Nvidia's, $NVDA, board to rehire Jensen Huang.

Attorney General Todd Blanche has also questioned the allegations surrounding Huang's departure, saying he has "certainly" not concluded that Alice Huang was a Chinese spy.

In a matter of days, the Trump Admin's public position has shifted from calling for Jensen Huang's replacement to openly supporting his reinstatement.

The Trump Administration and Nvidia's shareholders appear to be aligned.

Pressure on Nvidia's board is mounting.

posts.text:
At Tom Cruise's wedding in Italy, actress Leah Remini asked one simple question about the Scientology leader's missing wife: "Where is Shelly?"

Everyone at the table scattered.

Days later, after she filed internal complaints about Cruise, she was ordered to Florida and locked in interrogations for 90 straight days.

In 2006, The King of Queens star attended Cruise and Katie Holmes's wedding inside a medieval Italian castle. When she noticed leader David Miscavige's wife, Shelly, was nowhere to be seen, an official snapped back:

"You don't have the f*cking rank to be asking about a human being."

Following church policy, Remini wrote internal reports questioning why Cruise was treated like royalty above normal rules.

Instead of thanking her, church leadership summoned her to their Florida headquarters and put her inside a room with cameras.

On the table sat a thick stack of reports written against her by every single person on Tom Cruise's personal staff.

"Do you have sexual intentions toward him?" an interrogator demanded. "What are your evil intentions toward Tom Cruise?"

Every day for three months, from morning until night, she sat under questioning. Even when her mother visited, Remini was told to go grab a sandwich, eat it in the elevator, and get back inside the room within 10 minutes.

Having already donated millions of dollars to the organization, she finally broke after 90 days and retracted everything just to go home.

In 2013, she walked out for good and filed a missing person report for Shelly Miscavige with the LAPD. She later discovered the lieutenant handling the case had been paid to speak at a Scientology venue.

Shelly Miscavige has not been seen in public since 2007, while Cruise remains the church's biggest star.

Did Hollywood and Los Angeles authorities look the other way for two decades to protect Tom Cruise, or did police close the missing person case because nothing illegal could be proved?

posts.text:
In the original trilogy, Haymitch never tells Katniss and Peeta what the Capitol did to him. Not once.

He never says Lenore Dove's name. He never says his mom and his little brother were killed because he outsmarted the arena. He never says Snow murdered his girlfriend as punishment for that forcefield trick at the end of his Games.

Katniss and Peeta know he is an alcoholic. They know he is bitter and broken and that he won the 50th Games. That is it. They have no idea why.

And now after Sunrise on the Reaping, you finally understand why he was like that with them from day one.

Every piece of advice he gave them was him trying to stop them from losing what he lost, without ever being able to say it out loud.

When he told Katniss, "Don't let them make you into something you're not," that was Lenore Dove.

When he told Peeta, "Don't let them change you," that was him watching the Capitol torture Wiress and Mags and everyone he loved for helping him.

When he pushed Katniss and Peeta to play up the star-crossed lovers act, it was not because he believed in the romance. It was because he knew if the Capitol thought they were in love, Snow might let them both live. And if Snow thought they were rebelling, he would kill everyone they loved, just like he did to Haymitch.

He could not tell them the truth because the truth was a death sentence. If Katniss knew Snow kills victors' families for defiance, she would have been even more terrified. If Peeta knew, he would have tried to save everyone and gotten himself killed.

So he just drank, and he yelled, and he tried to keep them alive in the only way he knew how. By being cruel enough to make them listen, and broken enough that they would not ask him why.

Katniss only figures it out years later, after the war, when she finally understands what it cost him to be her mentor. He never got to tell his story. He just had to make sure her story did not end like his.
